title: scan-project and scan-animbp stop at 500 files without saying so
body:
## Summary
Both walkers cap at 500 files and report nothing when they stop.

## Description
scan-assets now reports truncated; these two walkers keep the same silent cap. scan-project also counts source files with no cap, so sourceFileCount can exceed what the class list covers.

## Flow
- Project with more than 500 headers is scanned
- Classes past the cap are absent
- The response looks complete

## Expected impact
Consumers can tell a partial class list from a complete one.

## Evaluation
Claim: A capped walk is reported as capped.
Before: 0 of 2 walkers disclose the cap
After: 2 of 2 disclose it
Method: simulation
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: Route test over a temp project of 501 headers asserting truncated true and false at 500.

title: checkLocalPath accepts a drive-less rooted path on Windows
body:
## Summary
A path such as \foo or /foo passes as absolute and lands on the server cwd's drive.

## Description
The guard refuses relative and drive-relative paths because they resolve against state nobody chose. A rooted path with no drive has the same property: the drive comes from the server's cwd. Refusing it is win32-only, and suites that mock fs with POSIX-style paths need checking first.

## Flow
- Caller sends /foo on Windows
- path.isAbsolute answers true
- The path resolves to C:\foo through the cwd drive

## Expected impact
The guard's stated rule holds for every shape on Windows.

## Evaluation
Claim: A drive-less rooted path is refused on win32.
Before: probe on Node 24.14 win32: \foo and /foo isAbsolute true, resolve C:\foo
After: refused with 400 on win32, unchanged on POSIX
Method: probe
Result: better
Gate: policy-tighten
instrument: pathGuard test on win32 for both shapes plus a run of every suite passing POSIX paths to the filesystem routes.

title: AssetInventory does not show that a scan was truncated
body:
## Summary
scan-assets now reports truncated, but the inventory UI does not read it.

## Description
The field shipped in 104b9e488. The Asset Inventory view still presents a capped result as the whole project, and its totals are partial.

## Flow
- A project over 2000 assets is scanned
- truncated is true in the response
- The view shows totals with no notice

## Expected impact
An operator sees that the inventory is partial.

## Evaluation
Claim: The view discloses a partial scan.
Before: 0 consumers read truncated
After: AssetInventory shows a notice when it is true
Method: simulation
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: Component test rendering the inventory with truncated true and asserting the notice; out of this round's paths.

title: quest-generation calls scan-project without moduleName, so a UE5 project yields no classes
body:
## Summary
The internal scan omits moduleName, which scan-project requires for UE5 projects.

## Description
scan-project answers 400 for a UE5 project without moduleName. quest-generation treats that as non-fatal and logs it, so on UE5 projects quest generation always runs with an empty class list.

## Flow
- Quest generation runs with a projectPath
- It posts only projectPath to scan-project
- UE5 detection answers 400 and classes stay empty

## Expected impact
Quest generation sees the project's real classes.

## Evaluation
Claim: A UE5 project's classes reach quest generation.
Before: by reading: request body at route.ts:46-50 has no moduleName and scan-project:550 refuses it
After: classes populated
Method: simulation
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: Route test with a temp UE5 project asserting a non-empty class list reaches the prompt; out of this round's paths.

title: verify-semantic reads every header at once while its siblings batch by 20
body:
## Summary
One unbatched Promise.all over all headers, against batches of 20 in scan-project and scan-animbp.

## Description
collectHeaders has no file cap, so a large Source tree opens every header concurrently. An EMFILE here is recorded as unreadable rather than failing, which would silently drop headers from the verdict.

## Flow
- Large Source tree
- All readFile calls start together
- Failures become unreadable entries

## Expected impact
Bounded file handle use and no spurious unreadable entries.

## Evaluation
Claim: Peak concurrent reads are bounded at 20.
Before: unmeasured; 1 of 3 routes unbatched
After: peak 20
Method: simulation
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: Spy on readFile counting peak in-flight calls over a temp tree of more than 20 headers.

title: generate/status GET can trigger a provider mesh download with no guard
body:
## Summary
A GET handler reaches a download through mcpGateForJob.

## Description
api-auth documents GET handlers as unguarded because they neither mutate nor start work. This one can fetch a provider mesh, though it needs a known jobId and the gate is memoised per job, so the exposure is narrow.

## Flow
- GET status for a completed job with a resultUrl
- mcpGateForJob downloads the mesh
- No operator check ran

## Expected impact
The one GET with a network side effect follows the guarded verbs.

## Evaluation
Claim: A cross-site GET cannot start a download.
Before: by reading: no requireOperator on the route
After: 403 for a cross-site Origin
Method: simulation
Result: better
Gate: policy-tighten
instrument: Route test with a cross-origin header and a mocked gate asserting no call; confirm the forge poll sends a same-origin Origin or none.

title: Browser callers send no operator token, so a token deployment locks the UI out
body:
## Summary
With POF_OPERATOR_TOKEN set, guarded routes answer 401 to the app's own browser calls.

## Description
No client code sends the token. That was already true of watch, pipeline-artifacts and the Blender routes; 2d58e2321 adds browse and the scans, including PathBrowser. Default local mode is unaffected. Whether a token deployment should inject the token, use a session, or stay API-only is a product decision.

## Flow
- Operator sets POF_OPERATOR_TOKEN
- The browser calls a guarded route with no token
- The route answers 401

## Expected impact
A token deployment has a working UI.

## Evaluation
Claim: The browser UI works under a configured token.
Before: 0 client call sites send a token
After: a decided auth path for the browser
Method: unmeasurable
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: direction
instrument: Operator decision on the browser credential path, then an e2e walk with the token set.
